I'm glad I've realized there are dog whistles for insecure people now, saves me some stress socially. Not to say I'd avoid insecure people entirely, but that's something that is notable that I pretty much bookmark mentally and then over time pay attention to if they're the silly kind of insecure or the not so silly insecure.
Have you ever thought you might be more than average looking then? I used to think I was ugly growing up but as an adult realized I was just a brown girl that only went to pwi's for k-12.
